original_test_intent: Verify every NVSM-managed LED is represented at the correct chassis/component location and reports the expected color/state/mode for the current platform condition.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected LED identity/location/function/color/state/blink manifest; run exact `nvsm show led` read-only; retain raw paths/values/status; compare completeness and current-state expectations; optionally correlate a human photo only when the project requires physical confirmation, without setting or toggling LEDs.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies expected LED manifest and, if required, confirms physical LED appearance; agent performs read-only collection/comparison.
required_inputs: Expected color/state/blink rules for current condition
Policy for required physical photo/observer confirmation
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, toggle identify LEDs or issue BMC LED writes
Do not equate reported state with physical light without required observer evidence
agent_execution_scope: Attach supplied physical correlation and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but cannot define correct without an LED/location/state manifest.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and map every returned LED path to the approved physical/function manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All LED information remains in scope; no active toggle is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce an expected/observed table keyed by device/location/function with reported state and optional physical-photo reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes correctness explicit while preserving read-only scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reported management state may not prove physical illumination unless the project requires and supplies observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: LED names and virtual indicators vary by platform/NVSM version; physical state can lag or differ after controller faults.

project_override_considerations: Project owner defines expected idle/fault/identify states and whether physical correlation is mandatory.
expected_evidence: Optional physical evidence and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target LED information correctness; reference/physical requirements are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and LED manifest are provisionable; reported-state collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Separates read-only reported LED state from optional physical verification and forbids turning inventory into a BMC mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A management property can report the commanded state even if an LED is disconnected or miswired. The source command proves controller-visible state; physical illumination needs separate observation when required, and the two evidence types must not be conflated.
